description: Act on a `proposed` decision from your terminal — cast your position (agree/object/abstain) or transition it (resolve/withdraw). Authority for resolve/withdraw is enforced server-side by the project's resolution mode (owner/per_type/group) — a client-asserted role is never trusted. Use `ad_view` first to see a decision's current state. Does not call the Anthropic API.

action.description: agree/object/abstain cast your own position on a proposed decision. resolve/withdraw transition the decision itself and require authority — owner-only in "owner" mode, the configured resolver (or owner override) in "per_type" mode, or full owner/release_manager/editor quorum (or an owner force-resolve) in "group" mode.

ad_id.description: The decision to act on, e.g. "AD-42".

comment.description: Optional note recorded alongside your position or transition.

name: decision_resolve
